author: PlsExplaiinn
body: Hello everyone, I have been banned from this server 8 moths ago and when I was scrolling through my history, this website popped up. I remember playing this and wanted to see if I could get unbanned. It is ok if I may not me unbanned but you know, just wanted to give it a try. Thank you all and I miss playing with you guys.
